Industries

The same disciplines, shaped by the sector they serve.

Every industry has its own pressures, vocabulary and rules. Below is how we think about the sectors where our services are most often useful.

  • 01

    Healthcare

    Less administration around the work of caring for people.Scheduling, records workflows and internal tools for clinics, practices and healthcare service providers.
  • 02

    Financial Services

    Careful automation for work where accuracy is the whole point.Document processing, client workflows and internal systems for advisers, lenders, insurers and finance teams.
  • 03

    Retail & E-commerce

    Orders, stock and customers, seen in one place.Order operations, inventory integrations and customer systems for shops selling online, in store or both.
  • 04

    Manufacturing & Logistics

    Clear information from the shop floor to the dispatch bay.Operational software, tracking tools and site infrastructure for producers, warehouses and distributors.
  • 05

    Professional Services

    More of the working week on client work.Client management, knowledge tools and workflow automation for consultancies, agencies, legal and accounting firms.
  • 06

    Startups & Growing Businesses

    A first version worth building on, and systems that keep pace with growth.Product development, foundational systems and practical automation for young and fast-growing companies.

A note on what this page claims. These pages describe how our services apply to each sector. They do not imply existing clients in a sector, industry certifications or specialist regulatory accreditation. Compliance requirements are identified and addressed project by project.
